messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: MONITOR ALERT — Elevated p95/p99 latency and CPU spikes on streaming workers in region us-west-2. Error rate for streaming responses up ~4x over baseline. Paging oncall: @oncall-elaine.

oncall-elaine: ACK. Jumping in. what's the scope? any customer-facing errors?

sre-dev: seeing long tail in push SSE connections, tail latency up to 9s for tokenized responses >512 tokens. Throughput dips when many concurrent streams. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streaming-usw2 (graphs: p95/p99 / cpu / inflight streams)

eng-runtime-bot: Repro logs from worker-42 attached. Stack trace points to backpressure during kv-cache flush; flush blocking async writes. Quick metric snapshot: GPU util ~95% on p4-class hosts.

oncall-elaine: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) traffic-shape to reduce concurrent streaming sessions, 2) impose per-connection token rate limit, 3) temporarily disable streaming responses in us-west-2 and fall back to blocking responses. which is least risky and fastest?

sre-dev: shaping requires edge config push and might take a minute; quickest path is flipping the streaming feature flag per-region to avoid the KV backpressure entirely.

product-ryan: Note: disabling streaming will degrade UX for streaming-first clients (progressive tokens). We need CS comms and a short banner.

support-jess: drafting a customer banner & emails. Will prioritize high-touch customers.

oncall-elaine: plan: step A) apply 30% concurrency reduction via edge rate rule to buy time. step B) if p99 or CPU don't improve in 10m, flip streaming off for us-west-2 and route to blocking endpoints. agree?

ops-hannah: fine by me. prepping rollback/runbook in case of regressions.

sre-dev: preparing rule, will push: 

```
# apply concurrency cap for streaming paths
edgectl rate add --region us-west-2 --path "/v1/stream" --concurrency 0.7 --reason "incident 1842001234"
```

oncall-elaine: executing now.

eng-runtime-bot: edgectl accepted the rule; returning 200. streaming throughput down ~28% in 60s; p99 decreased from 9s -> 4.2s for affected hosts.

oncall-elaine: good signal. monitor for 5m and report.

(5m)

sre-dev: after 5m, p99 still trending high; CPU still ~92% on hot hosts and queue depths remain. error rate unchanged.

oncall-elaine: prepare to flip streaming off. eng-runtime-bot / ops-hannah ready to run region toggle?

eng-runtime-bot: command to disable streaming per-region: 

```
rdctl feature toggle streaming_responses --region us-west-2 --state off --reason "emergency mitigation 1842001234"
```

ops-hannah: staging canary: route 10% traffic to fallback blocking handler, verify metrics for that shard, then ramp.

oncall-elaine: execute canary at 10%.

eng-runtime-bot: canary applied. 10% traffic now on blocking handler; immediate p99 improvement observed for that subset.

support-jess: pushing CS notify: "We are temporarily disabling streaming in us-west-2 to stabilize latency. Streaming clients will receive final responses instead of incremental tokens. We expect resolution within a few hours."

product-ryan: agree — include a short status page entry and callouts for enterprise accounts.

(15m)

sre-dev: canary ramp to 100% complete; streaming disabled in us-west-2. p99 dropped from ~9s -> ~1.8s, error rate back to baseline, GPU and CPU utilization on heavy hosts dropped to ~66%.

oncall-elaine: confirmed. mitigation executed: streaming disabled in us-west-2 at 1842004500. Pausing runtime deploys and scaling down aggressive autoscale policies.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2 due to customer-facing UX impact. Pager rotation updated.

support-jess: Customer-impact summary: 12 paying customers actively using streaming; 3 flagged high-touch accounts affected (acct-42, acct-77, acct-101). Phone/emails sent to those customers. No billing changes planned.

ops-hannah: rollback/re-enable plan: hotfix branch `hotfix/kv-flush-guard` includes kv-cache flush guard and reduced flush concurrency. we'll test in staging then do a controlled canary re-enable.

eng-runtime-bot: deploying hotfix to staging now (build 7a2f9), running integration tests.

oncall-elaine: Handoff: I'm on-call until 02:00Z. If rolling metrics spike, page me. TL;DR for next shift: streaming disabled in us-west-2, mitigation successful, re-enable pending staged hotfix and canary.

product-ryan: postmortem owners: eng-runtime (owner: mira) and SRE (owner: dev). draft postmortem and timeline please.

support-jess: I'll post status page update + customer follow-ups once we have a re-enable ETA.

incident-bot: Next scheduled update in 1h. :white_check_mark:

ops-hannah: perf snapshot stored at s3://incidents/1842001234/metrics-snapshot.json

mira: will run rollback test in ~30m and report results here.

oncall-elaine: thanks everyone — closing live mitigation. keep ongoing updates in this thread for re-enable progress and postmortem notes."
